text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to conclude the Lawrence Park Transportation Plan, a study intended to inform the detailed design phase and implementation phases of the Lawrence Park Neighbourhood Investigation of Basement Flooding (Area 20) and Road Improvement Class Environmental Assessment (EA); make interim road improvements in advance of the Environmental Assessment implementation; and make road improvements that are independent of the Environmental Assessment implementation. The Lawrence Park Transportation Plan was initiated in response to a request of North York Community Council in 2019.
